claims: Siena, Italy is a historic city in the Tuscany region of central Italy.
Siena, Italy is located roughly 30 miles (48 km) south of Florence.
Siena, Italy is built on three hills.
Siena, Italy is surrounded by a 7-kilometer fortified wall.
Siena, Italy is about 43 miles (70 km) south of Florence.
Siena, Italy is 143 miles (230 km) north of Rome.
Siena, Italy is surrounded by vineyards and olive groves.
The Piazza del Campo in Siena, Italy is the site of the Palio horse race.
